description: This file defines a React component named SessionsByType which renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by session type. It imports React and chart components from the 'recharts' library, as well as a local chart theme module. The component handles different states like loading, error, and no data, and includes a custom tooltip and label truncation for better display.

methods.name: SessionsByType({ data = [], loading = false, error = "", onFilterChange, })
methods.description: React functional component rendering a bar chart of session types with props for data, loading state, error message, and a filter change handler.

methods.name: truncateLabel(label, max = 14)
methods.description: Helper function to truncate labels longer than a specified maximum length, appending an ellipsis.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: React component for rendering a customized tooltip within the chart, showing session counts for a specific label.
